title: Native Modules
seo: Custom native modules for React Native apps
meta: Custom Swift and Kotlin native modules that give your React Native app device features it lacks. From $150, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: React Native native modules in Swift and Kotlin
overview: Some features need direct access to the phone, such as a Bluetooth device, a home screen widget, a custom camera or a vendor SDK. We write the native code in Swift and Kotlin and wrap it so your JavaScript can call it like any other function. You receive typed methods, an example screen that uses the module, notes for your developers and tests on a real device.

faq: What can a native module do that JavaScript cannot?

It can reach device features that React Native does not expose, such as Bluetooth peripherals, background tasks, widgets, secure hardware and vendor SDKs. JavaScript then calls it like any normal function.
Can you wrap a third-party SDK?
Yes, if the SDK has a licence that allows it and a public iOS or Android library. Send us the documentation and we check it is workable before you order.
Can I reuse the module in other apps?
Yes. You own the source. We keep the module self-contained, so you can copy it into another project or publish it as a package, and we can do the packaging for you as an add-on.
Yes, through Expo development builds and a config plugin. Without the plugin, the module needs a small manual native setup, which we document. The config plugin add-on removes that step.
